preconditions.description: The number of rounds in the tournament is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The number of outcomes that sponsors can change is between 1 and the minimum of 2^n - 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The minimum possible number of the winner is between 1 and 2^n inclusive.
The output is the minimum possible number of the winner modulo 10^9 + 7.
